svg.text: GHOSTED: Juno the barista, model sheet v1 (Illustrator, 2026-11-26)
Upright, neutral, symmetric turnaround (rest: the cup in both hands). Body map v1 landmarks. Direction A (the hourglass). Palette rows only.
top of the puff
hairline (centre)
eye line = ear points
neckline
shoulder joint
waist = apron tie
hem
sole
FRONT
3/4 (front turned to viewer-left)
SIDE (facing viewer-left)
BACK
PALETTE (existing rows only, seats/lena-park.md)
5 #7A4A2E top, sleeves, skirt; shoes: the dark read
6 #F4A672 apron: bib, straps, skirt; cheeks
7 #D4503A apron tie + back bow, pocket, scrunchie, marker
25 #4A3226 hair: the puff
15 #F2C79E skin: head, ears, neck, forearms, hands
26 #2F3E5C leggings
23 #FFF8EE the cup and lid; teeth; eye glint
22 #2B1E16 ink: outline, eyes, brows, mouth, cup text
Shade: base x 0.85 (neutral grey multiplier).
SHAPE RULES
- Toy pawn, the HOURGLASS: round shoulders,
pinched at the apron tie, flared hem. 1.0 x Kit.
- Hair pulled back into a high round puff with
a red scrunchie. High clean hairline; strand
lines ON the hair only. No fringe.
- Coffee-brown top (rolled sleeves) and skirt;
apricot bib apron; red tie, back bow, pocket.
- The cup: white, lid, a written line. Text at
card size; just a cup at the game camera.
- Mouth: rest = closed smile line; laugh and
talk = Ricky style (dark fill, teeth band).
- Joins: sleeve, brown cuff ball at the elbow,
skin forearm, ball hand (notes).
HAND OVER A CUP: her right arm forward, cup on the palm
(red: shoulder, elbow, wrist). Front, 3/4, side. Smile; the other hand at her side
A SMALL WAVE: her right hand up by the shoulder, 3 frames
the hand rocks out and back (about 0.3 s a beat); the cup stays in the left hand
wave 1
wave 2
wave 3
WRITING ON THE CUP: cup up in the left hand, marker
in the right; head down 14 deg, eyes down; then she turns it to you
write (front)
write (3/4)
then: 'here you go'
EXPRESSIONS (front)
rest: calm smile
laugh (Ricky mouth)
dry: one brow
writing: eyes down
64 px SILHOUETTE (front, 3/4; 1x and x4)
THE CUP AT CARD SIZE (front)
the line is real text (a decal in 3D); at the game camera it is just a cup
LINEUPS AT THE GAME CAMERA (x2): Juno estimate on the real Brett v1 renders with Kit, Ricky, Dot, Brett, 3 Ghosties and the ATS.
Grass: colour, grey. Path: colour, grey (Lena's formula).
top 5 vs grass 1: 4.52:1; vs path 3: 5.06:1 (the dark read). Hair 25 vs grass: 7.25:1
apron 6 vs grass 1: 1.22:1; vs path 3: 1.37:1 (low: it sits inside the brown, apron 6 vs top 5: 3.70:1)
tie 7 vs apron 6: 2.11:1; vs top 5: 1.76:1; cup 23 vs apron 6: 1.89:1; cup 23 vs top 5: 7.00:1
hair 25 vs skin 15: 7.57:1; top 5 vs Brett vest 7: 1.76:1; vs Kit 14: 1.55:1; vs Ricky 17: 1.84:1; vs Dot 11: 1.25:1
In grey: a dark puff, a light face, a dark hourglass with a mid-light apron front and a white cup, dark legs.
GAME CAMERA NEXT TO KIT (x3): rest, hand over, wave, write, Kit; grass then path; 1x at the right
FACE CHECK AT THE GAME CAMERA (x3 of the 1x face): grass, path, grey
SIZE (estimate; Viet's blockout sets it):
Target 1.0 x Kit = 75 px, puff included.
This tile: 75 x 43 px facing the camera.
1 u = 3.41 mm: about 1.12 m to the puff top,
0.98 m to the hair cap (Kit 0.977 m).
